# Wael Almouselli - Comprehensive Professional Profile

## 1. Professional Summary
Wael Almouselli is a Full-Stack Web Developer and Digital Media Buyer. He specializes in building high-performance, SEO/GEO-optimized websites and managing high-ROI online advertising campaigns. Wael extensively leverages advanced AI tools for media generation, interior design rendering, and custom audio production to create compelling commercial content.

## 2. Core Technical Skills

### Web Development & Infrastructure
- **Languages & Platforms:** HTML, CSS, JavaScript, WordPress.
- **Infrastructure:** Cloudflare (Minification, Caching, DNS, SSL), GitHub.
- **Search & AI Optimization:** Technical SEO, GEO (Generative Engine Optimization), Schema Markup (JSON-LD), Meta tags, and strict mobile responsiveness.

### Digital Media Buying & Marketing
- **Campaign Management:** Targeted advertising across Meta (Instagram/Facebook) and Google Ads.
- **Content Strategy:** Development of social media ad content, Instagram Reels, carousel posts, and promotional copy featuring high-converting hooks and CTAs.

### AI Media & Audio Production
- **Visual AI Generation:** Creation of photorealistic renders and promotional videos for modern kitchens, walk-in closets, luxury interiors, and home decor.
- **Audio Production:** Generation of custom instrumental background music (grand piano, lofi, deep house, corporate ambient) for commercial video reels.

## 3. Notable Projects & Portfolio

- **waelalmouselli.net (Personal Portfolio):** Custom-built and deployed with complete SEO/GEO optimization, advanced Meta tags, Schema markup, and Cloudflare integration.
- **Swiss Kitchen & Wardrobe:** Developed the full digital and web presence. Built the website using HTML/CSS/JS, hosted via Cloudflare. Produced digital ad campaigns, promotional reel prompts, video outros, and marketing graphics.
- **Taraf Style (tarafstyleforabaya.com):** E-commerce website technical optimization, focusing on mobile responsiveness, Meta tags, and Schema markup.
- **البيت الملكي & المحترف للمطابخ:** Developed comprehensive social media branding, logo concepts, Instagram posts, and marketing captions for interior design campaigns.
